title: Invalid-score / degradation path
description: Evaluation window supplies an input-side condition for invalid-score / degradation handling without asserting a runtime evaluation status or embedding ground truth in detector inputs. Synthetic only.

normalBehavior.summary: Normal feature traffic with later infra degradation markers.

evaluationExpectations.notes: Evaluation-side only. Ground truth class is unknown during degradation. The generated corpus does not assert EvaluationStatus.INVALID_SCORE itself; that is a decision-engine runtime output only real evaluation/replay can determine.

assertions.statement: Later evaluation events carry unknown expectedClass in the sidecar and category=invalid-score; the events themselves carry no evaluationStatuses and no anomalyScore/policyScore.
